WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(account_count) as avg_count
  FROM district_counts
  GROUP BY region
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT dc.district_id, dc.region, dc.account_count,
         dc.account_count - ra.avg_count as above_avg,
         ra.avg_count
  FROM district_counts dc
  JOIN region_averages ra ON dc.region = ra.region
  WHERE dc.account_count > ra.avg_count
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(account_count) as overall_avg_count
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT 
  aa.district_id,
  aa.region,
  aa.account_count,
  aa.above_avg,
  aa.account_count / oa.overall_avg_count as ratio
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
